svg.title: A spending shock (households less patient) under the rule
svg.desc: Three panels over 16 quarters: output gap, inflation and policy rate after households become less patient and the natural rate of interest rises by 1 percentage point a year. On impact the gap is 0.259 %, inflation 0.352 and the rate 0.658 percentage points a year; all three return to zero. Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.

g.text: A spending shock (households less patient) under the rule

text.style: fill: #8b949e; font: 11px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Three-equation New Keynesian model, quarterly, calibration as in Galí (2015), ch. 3. Pure simulation, no data.

text.style: fill: #8b949e; font: 9.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research. Woodford (2003); Clarida, Galí and Gertler (1999); Galí (2015).

text.style: fill: #8b949e; font: 10px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Rule: i = 1.5 pi + 0.125 x. Shock persistence 0.5.
